newsitem.title: USA: Senate Democrat sees balanced budget deal soon.
newsitem.headline: Senate Democrat sees balanced budget deal soon.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said he believed Congress and President Clinton could agree on a balanced budget plan by spring.

"I believe we can reach an historic milestone," he said in a speech to the Economic Policy Insititute. "I believe Congress and the president can agree by spring on a plan to end nearly three decades of red ink.
"This year, for the first time since 1969, we can actually balance the federal budget."
